span.normalized: The identity of these customers has changed from year to year and may continue to change in the future. In 2026, one Integrated Memory customer accounted for approximately 20% of our net sales, while the Advanced Computing customer that accounted for approximately 18% of our net sales in each of 2025 and 2024, and a different Integrated Memory customer that accounted for approximately 14% of our net sales in 2025, did not account for more than 10% of our net sales in 2026. In some cases, our customers also compete with us and/or are our major suppliers.
